So, I was dinking around with python and chat bots the other day, and I made one from some API's lying around, all on the raspberry pi itself, no internet. It worked, but after the database gets larger than 100 entries or so, the pi has a hard time keeping up. After a while response times took well over 5-10 seconds depending on what you wrote. That was just no good, so I've set up something a little more fun:

James

James uses google's speech recognition tech, cleverbot's chat algorithms, and eSpeak as a voice synthesizer. Essentially, it makes your pi a little bot you can talk to, and which will "speak" back, somewhat intelligently.

It's real rough around the edges, but for anyone who doesn't want to spend hours digging through this stuff, it might be a good start, or a solution entirely. GitHub Page
